import hashlib
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys

enabled = os.environ['TENSORFOLD_SSD_BATCH_GATHER']
if enabled not in ('0', '1'):
    raise SystemExit('TENSORFOLD_SSD_BATCH_GATHER must be exactly 0 or 1')
path = Path(sys.argv[1])
data = path.read_bytes()
baseline = 'a0d19115834bd6144a638cd5ceaac60767dcb5afe097316bfe3e0dc4c66b20fe'
patched = 'fa06db912a4d02437875a7e146f1ccf4daf36fcf1093df9b50caf9ea316b03bf'
if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != baseline:
    raise SystemExit('TensorFold SSD batch patch failed: pinned forward.py SHA-256 no longer matches')
old = '''    for layer in w.layers:
        if layer.ple is not None:
            p = layer.ple
            for (st, tokens), (_, a0, _) in zip(windows, segs):
                toks = np.asarray(tokens, dtype=np.int64)
                ids = p.ngram.ids(st.ple_history, toks)
                st.ple_last = (st.ple_history, toks)
                lookups.append((p, ids, a0 * (ids.size // len(toks))))
'''
new = '''    for layer in w.layers:
        if layer.ple is not None:
            p = layer.ple
            per_window = []
            for (st, tokens), (_, a0, _) in zip(windows, segs):
                toks = np.asarray(tokens, dtype=np.int64)
                ids = p.ngram.ids(st.ple_history, toks)
                st.ple_last = (st.ple_history, toks)
                if w.x3 is None:
                    per_window.append(ids)
                else:
                    lookups.append((p, ids, a0 * (ids.size // len(toks))))
            if w.x3 is None:
                ids = per_window[0] if len(per_window) == 1 else np.concatenate(per_window, axis=0)
                lookups.append((p, ids, 0))
'''
if enabled == '1':
    source = data.decode('utf-8')

        raise SystemExit('TensorFold SSD batch patch failed: expected staging block no longer matches once')
    data = source.replace(old, new, 1).encode('utf-8')
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != patched:
        raise SystemExit('TensorFold SSD batch patch failed: result differs from the benchmarked patch')
    path.write_bytes(data)
print(f'[ieti] Flash Next SSD batch gather={enabled}, SHA-256={hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}', flush=True)

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys

from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download

revision = os.environ['MODEL_REVISION']
snapshot = Path(snapshot_download(repo_id=os.environ['MODEL_ID'], revision=revision, max_workers=4))
if snapshot.name != revision or not (snapshot / 'config.json').is_file():
    raise SystemExit(f'Unexpected model snapshot: {snapshot}')
index = json.loads((snapshot / 'model.safetensors.index.json').read_text())
shards = set(index['weight_map'].values())
if not shards or any(Path(name).is_absolute() or '..' in Path(name).parts or not (snapshot / name).is_file() for name in shards):
    raise SystemExit('Pinned model snapshot is missing weights or has an invalid shard index')
print(f'[ieti] Verified pinned model {os.environ["MODEL_ID"]}@{revision}', file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
print(snapshot)
PY_MODEL_SNAPSHOT

# CLI settings below are unchanged from the measured baseline:
# --backend cuda: use GB10; --host/--port: listen inside the container.
# --name: canonical model ID returned by /v1/models; weights use local path.
# --context/--parallel: request token limit and maximum concurrent streams.
# --thinking/low/1024: enable reasoning with low effort and a 1024-token
# reasoning budget. --temperature 0.1: default sampling randomness.
# Requests may override supported reasoning/sampling defaults.
# --kv-dtype int8: quantize attention KV cache; weights remain affine 4-bit.
# --ple-on-ssd: read PLE n-gram tables from SSD rather than preload them.
# --vision: load the upstream image tower and reserve its workspace.
# --mtp-drafts 6: at most six internal draft tokens per round.
# --mtp-confidence 0.60: stop later drafts below this probability (the
# upstream CUDA default is 0.70; 0.60 is the previously tested setting).
# --no-update-check: keep serving without background version checks.
exec tensorfold serve "${MODEL_PATH}" \
  --backend cuda \
  --host 0.0.0.0 \
  --port 8000 \
  --name "${MODEL_ID}" \
  --context "${CONTEXT_LENGTH}" \
  --parallel "${PARALLEL_STREAMS}" \
  --thinking \
  --reasoning-effort low \
  --thinking-budget 1024 \
  --temperature 0.1 \
  --kv-dtype int8 \
  --ple-on-ssd \
  --vision \
  --mtp-drafts 6 \
  --mtp-confidence 0.60 \
  --no-update-check
